description: Use for any task that will end in a claim about tests, the build, or whether the work is done: making tests pass, fixing a failing test, fixing a bug, implementing a feature, refactoring, debugging, getting CI green. Runs eight shell commands against the real diff and requires their raw output before success can be reported.
